title.en: Personal, Family, Lineage, and the State

location.en: Seminar Room 341, East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室

hosts.en: Datong Society × C. V. Starr East Asian Library
hosts.zh: 大同学社 × C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆

description.en: Beginning with the speaker’s Chinese translation of Joseph W. Esherick’s Ancestral Leaves, this lecture draws on more than two decades of research into the papers of the Chou family and on the archives of Chinese scholars overseas. It explores how private documents can reconstruct historical contexts and illuminate the interplay of individual, family, lineage, and state in twentieth-century China.
description.zh: 从翻译周锡瑞（Joseph W. Esherick）教授《叶：百年动荡中的一个中国家庭》谈起，结合二十余年整理周馥、周学熙、周叔弢、周一良等周氏家族文献的研究，以及对海外中国学人档案的考察，探讨如何从私人文献重建历史情境，理解个人、家庭、家族与国家在二十世纪中国社会变迁中的互动。

subtitle.en: Social Transformation in Twentieth-Century China and Family History Research
subtitle.zh: 二十世纪中国社会变迁与家族史研究

title.en: Book Talk with Liu Zongkun: Lives Remembered and Roads Traveled

speaker.en: Liu Zongkun (known online as 徒步的骑手), Independent Attorney, Writer, and YouTuber
speaker.zh: 刘宗坤（网名「徒步的骑手」）, 独立律师、作家、YouTuber

location.en: Seminar Room 341, East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室

description.en: A book talk on Liu Zongkun’s essay collection, published by 1 Plus Books in 2026. The essays revisit people he knew in China, met over two decades in Texas, and encountered while walking and cycling abroad. Their stories raise a question familiar to many who have moved away: what makes a place home? A conversation with UC Berkeley students, followed by a book signing.
description.zh: 散文集《异乡故人》（壹嘉出版，2026）新书分享。书中写到作者在中国故乡的亲友师长、移居得克萨斯二十余年间结识的人，以及徒步与骑行途中偶遇的陌生人。作者借这些人物故事，回望移居经历，追问故乡与归属的意义。与 UC 学生座谈，现场签售。

hosts.zh: 大同学社 × 壹嘉人文学社
